_comment: Pickup tuning, one entry per pickup type (matched by name, order does not matter).
radiusMeters: how close a player's CENTRE must get to the pickup's centre to
collect it. The player is 2.3 m wide, so 1.15 m means touching it with your
edge; 2.0 m is a comfortable walk-over. Allowed range: above 0, at most 20.
A type left out uses the default of 2.0 m. Restart the server after editing.
